## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Credit stress rising — HYG (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -1.01%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -1.33% | 1M: -2.26%) BELOW TREND; Cyclical vs Defensive ↓ falling (1W: -3.51% | 1M: -4.23%) indicating defensive posture; note VXX (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -5.97%) BELOW TREND shows some fear easing.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress EASING/then rising: HYG/LQD show deterioration — CREDIT STRESS ↑ (HYG (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -1.01%) BELOW TREND; LQD (1W: -1.33% | 1M: -2.26%) BELOW TREND). Dollar tightening: UUP proxy Dollar Strength ↑ rising (1W: +1.02% | 1M: +1.16%) ABOVE TREND; Energy rally lifting breakevens — XLE (1W: +6.46% | 1M: +11.29%) ABOVE TREND and Breakeven Inflation → flat (1W: +0.38% | 1M: +1.64%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tightening: TLT (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -4.28%) BELOW TREND showing bond weakness and Yield Curve ↓ falling (1W: -1.92% | 1M: -3.52%) BELOW TREND; Dollar strength (↑ rising) is pressuring global liquidity.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.46% | 1M: +11.29%). Tech in CORRECTION: XLK CORRECTION (1W: -1.12% | 1M: +12.09%) with short-term weakness vs month. Financials showing weakness: XLF (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND — style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US in CORRECTION: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +3.53%) while EMs lag — EEM CORRECTION (1W: -2.37% | 1M: +1.71%) and China FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.81% | 1M: -3.66%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation cooling: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -5.59% | 1M: -6.91%), IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -1.57%), IBIT in CORRECTION (1W: -5.02% | 1M: +0.58%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodities bifurcated: Oil strong — USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +26.08%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +23.94%); Copper CPER in CORRECTION (1W: -6.95% | 1M: +1.68%); Precious metals weak — GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -4.95% | 1M: -6.92%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy momentum intact: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.46% | 1M: +11.29%) and UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +9.68%) — clear sector leadership.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND) and credit deterioration (HYG/LQD BELOW TREND). DIVERGENCE: Tech/semis (XLK, SOXX, QQQ) in CORRECTION (1W negative, 1M positive) — MINOR divergence but watch for momentum fade.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor defensive exposures and energy given current regime — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.46% | 1M: +11.29%); reduce exposure to speculative/assets vulnerable to risk-off: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -5.59% | 1M: -6.91%), IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -1.57%); monitor credit and dollar.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.46% | 1M: +11.29%), Energy/Commodities ETFs USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +26.08%). BEARISH: GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -4.95% | 1M: -6.92%), XBI BELOW TREND (1W: -6.02% | 1M: -7.98%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Oil — USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +26.08%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +23.94%). BEARISH: Gold GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -4.95% | 1M: -6.92%), Silver SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -14.83% | 1M: -7.28%).

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~27.6 (fear metric; below recent peaks) — VXX (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -5.97%) BELOW TREND; Credit spread ~0.74 (stress signal) — Credit Spread (1W: +0.69% | 1M: +1.16%) ABOVE TREND; SPY/TLT ~8.84 (stocks vs bonds flat but above trend) — SPY (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +3.53%) CORRECTION; XLK/XLF ratio 3.39 (watch tech vs financials pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. HYG (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -1.01%) and LQD (1W: -1.33% | 1M: -2.26%) BELOW TREND with cyclicals lagging (Cyclical vs Defensive ↓ falling) confirm defensive posture. Energy showing relative strength — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.46% | 1M: +11.29%) while Tech in CORRECTION (XLK CORRECTION (1W: -1.12% | 1M: +12.09%)); key risk to monitor is rising credit stress and the tech momentum divergence.
